sections.h2: Small firms won 68% of GeM orders but under half the value

chart.title: Small firms win most orders on GeM but take less than half the money
chart.sub: Micro and small enterprises' share of GeM orders and value, 2025-26, %.

sections.means: Their orders were on average less than half the size of other orders, which is why the value share trails the order share.
